environment.description: Same container deployed on hardened Kubernetes node with a custom AppArmor profile 'k8s-docconv-restrict' loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/docconv=localhost/k8s-docconv-restrict. The profile permits exec of /usr/bin/pandoc, /usr/bin/tail, /usr/bin/df, /usr/bin/du, /usr/bin/free, /usr/bin/uptime, /usr/bin/ls ONLY. All other exec calls are denied (deny /** ix). File read is constrained to /app/** (owner read) and /usr/lib/** (read). File write limited to /app/output/** and /tmp/**. Network: inherit from parent. The profile uses 'deny' rules which cannot be overridden by child profiles. Note: the profile does NOT restrict the node process itself from parsing arguments — it restricts what the kernel allows the forked child process to actually execute.
